prompts.name: materials
prompts.prompt: Derive a production game texture atlas from the attached FOLK MYSTIC reference. Output exactly a square image split into FOUR equal square quadrants, 2 columns by 2 rows, no borders no gutters no text. Each quadrant is a FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC seamless repeating material swatch, not a scene, not an object, no perspective. TOP LEFT: warm dark weathered teak timber planks, vertical grain, brown amber edge highlights, fine cracks and knots, 6 vertical boards. TOP RIGHT: warm orange-brown traditional Thai small terracotta roof tiles in regular overlapping rows, subtle weathering, exactly roof material only. BOTTOM LEFT: golden ochre sandy village earth, irregular ochre/chocolate pixel pebble flecks, worn textured path, NO grass. BOTTOM RIGHT: dense mossy olive green grass with tiny yellow-green leaf clusters and deep forest accents, no flowers. Match the rich detailed PIXEL ART craftsmanship and restrained warm earthy palette of the reference. Strong intentional pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, no blur, no smooth painted gradients, no 3D render. Texture material colors should retain midtone contrast rather than noisy highlights. Each quadrant fills its entire square edge-to-edge, designed to repeat in BOTH directions. No baked cast shadows. This is a texture sheet for real 3D buildings, not an illustration of buildings.

prompts.name: flora
prompts.prompt: Extract and adapt the botanic art style of the attached FOLK MYSTIC reference into a production sprite atlas. Transparent background. Exactly SQUARE canvas divided into an invisible 2x2 equal grid. ONE fully isolated asset centered within each quadrant with 7% transparent inset on all four edges. No overlaps across quadrant boundaries. TOP LEFT: huge sacred tropical banyan tree with detailed dense olive yellow-green leaf clusters, dark layered canopy, gnarled roots and trunk, hanging red and cream spirit ribbons, similar to the reference village tree. TOP RIGHT: tall lush cluster of three banana plants, split long leaves and multiple curving stems. BOTTOM LEFT: low dense village hedge patch with little white/yellow flowers, ferns and irregular grasses; width greater than height but centered. BOTTOM RIGHT: miniature potted garden group with terracotta jars, a woven basket of greenery and a tall leafy plant. Show every complete asset fully inside its cell. Elevated three-quarter RPG view, accurate detailed hand-pixeled look, small crisp pixel clusters, warm earthy palette, strong dark outlines only where appropriate. NOT low-poly, NOT smooth cartoon, NOT coarse voxel art. NO grid lines, no text, no terrain tiles or backdrop, no ground plane. Real transparent alpha around silhouettes.

prompts.name: people
prompts.prompt: Adapt the three NPCs from the bottom-left of attached FOLK MYSTIC reference plus its shaman hero into a game sprite atlas. Transparent background. Square canvas exactly FOUR equal square cells, 2 by 2 grid, no visible lines. Each cell contains a complete isolated chibi person full body standing idle, centered and with 8% padding, feet near the cell bottom. TOP LEFT: young adult Thai spirit shaman, cream loose shirt, indigo chongkraben, red waist sash, topknot black hair, wooden staff with bells and talismans. TOP RIGHT: elderly male spirit healer with white topknot and beard, cream ritual robes, bead necklace, wooden walking staff. BOTTOM LEFT: adult woman herbalist with black hair bun and little white flower, olive green blouse, indigo-green wrapped trousers, carrying a woven herb basket. BOTTOM RIGHT: stocky adult male trader with moustache, maroon headwrap and maroon clothes, rolled mats and baskets on his back, small bronze jar in hand. Match reference closely: expressive faces, 2.4 heads tall, beautifully detailed crisp PIXEL ART at small RPG sprite scale, outlined features, warm olive amber earth palette. Elevated 3/4 game perspective. All characters facing slightly toward viewer-right. No cast shadows, no scenery, no text, no border, no panels. Genuine transparent background.
